_readme: Privacy glass copy for the customer screen. Edit name, aka, desc, and privacy (1 = outlines still visible, 5 = detail gone). The Noble site does not publish privacy ratings — leave privacy null unless Nick sets one. Reed (3) and Satin Etch (5) are still the old generic numbers. Andersen patterns have photos in assets/obscure/. Milgard patterns are names and descriptions only (no photos). Do not add C650/C700 — the site uses both codes for fiberglass. Order inside each section is the order on screen.
pageNote: Glass facing a tub or shower, with the bottom edge under 60 inches above the floor, has to be tempered unless the glass is more than 60 inches horizontally from the water.

sections.title: Andersen
sections.lead: Five privacy patterns. Andersen calls this privacy patterned glass. All of them let daylight through.
notes: Cascade and Reed can run vertical or horizontal. The direction is set when the glass is made and has to be on the order.
Available tempered. Both panes are tempered. With High-Performance Impact-Resistant glass, only the outside pane is tempered.

patterns.name: Cascade
patterns.desc: Runs of water frozen into the surface. Vertical or horizontal — say which way on the order.

patterns.name: Fern
patterns.desc: A feathered crystalline chip with a frosted look. The most decorative of the five.

patterns.name: Obscure
patterns.desc: Andersen's standard patterned obscure glass. An even, fine stipple with no direction to it. The usual bathroom ask.

patterns.name: Reed
patterns.desc: Fluted bars. The strongest distortion in the set, and the most architectural. Common on entry sidelights. Vertical or horizontal — say which way on the order.

patterns.name: Satin Etch
patterns.desc: A pearlescent glass with no pattern to read. A way to share light between two spaces and still keep privacy.

sections.title: Milgard
sections.lead: Nine patterns, by name and description only. No Milgard privacy-glass photos in the app yet.
notes: V300 Trinsic does not offer Aquatex, Glue Chip, or Frosted Glue Chip. Those three are marked on the card.
The other six are listed for V400 Tuscany, V300 Trinsic, V250 Style Line, and A250 aluminum.
No privacy rating is published. Ask to see a real sample — a screen cannot match the glass.

patterns.name: P516
patterns.desc: Fine, even granular texture with no direction to it.
patterns.seriesNote: V400 Tuscany, V300 Trinsic, V250 Style Line, A250 aluminum

patterns.name: #42 Clear
patterns.desc: Coarse pebbled texture, despite the name.
patterns.seriesNote: V400 Tuscany, V300 Trinsic, V250 Style Line, A250 aluminum

patterns.name: Aquatex
patterns.desc: Rounded ripple, like water sitting on the surface.
patterns.seriesNote: V400 Tuscany, V250 Style Line, A250 aluminum

patterns.name: Delta Frost
patterns.seriesNote: V400 Tuscany, V300 Trinsic, V250 Style Line, A250 aluminum

patterns.name: Glue Chip
patterns.seriesNote: V400 Tuscany, V250 Style Line, A250 aluminum

patterns.name: Frosted Glue Chip

patterns.seriesNote: V400 Tuscany, V250 Style Line, A250 aluminum

patterns.name: Narrow Reed

patterns.seriesNote: V400 Tuscany, V300 Trinsic, V250 Style Line, A250 aluminum

patterns.name: Satin Etch
